modules.name: VCA
modules.description: JX-AMP: two-channel VCA with linear or exponential response

modules.name: ADSR
modules.description: JX-ENV: ADSR envelope with curve, AD and loop modes, inverted output and end-of-cycle trigger

modules.name: VCO
modules.description: JX-OSC: VCO with octave switch, shape morph, sub oscillator and unison

modules.name: VCF
modules.description: JX-FLT: ladder VCF with lowpass, bandpass, highpass and notch, 12/24 dB, keytracking and envelope input

modules.name: LFO
modules.description: JX-LFO: low-frequency oscillator with sine, triangle, saw and square, clock sync, reset, offset and invert

modules.name: Noise
modules.description: JX-NSE: white, pink, red, violet, blue, gray and black noise with level

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: JX-MIX: four-channel mixer with level, CV and mute per channel and a master level

modules.name: SEQ
modules.description: JX-SEQ: 8-step CV and gate sequencer with internal tempo or external clock, length, run and reset

modules.name: Delay
modules.description: JX-DLY: mono delay from 1 ms to 10 s with feedback, tone and dry/wet mix

modules.name: Quantizer
modules.description: JX-QNT: quantizer to ten scales on any root, octave shift and a trigger on note changes

modules.name: Random
modules.description: JX-RND: sample & hold and smooth random voltages at an internal rate or on a clock
